title: Do you need an SEO?
measures: Google's advice on hiring an SEO: questions to ask, audits with read-only Search Console access, warnings about ranking promises and link schemes
limitations: The 2026-06-05 version suggests asking what results to expect and in what timeframe but does not itself state a typical number of months.

title: SEO Starter Guide
measures: Basics of crawling, indexing and content; states some changes take effect in a few hours and others several months, and suggests waiting a few weeks to assess impact
limitations: General guidance for all sites; not specific to dental or local search.

title: In-depth guide to how Google Search works
measures: Crawling, indexing and serving stages; Google does not accept payment to rank and does not promise to crawl, index or serve any page
limitations: Conceptual overview; does not disclose ranking weights.

title: Google Search technical requirements
measures: Minimum eligibility: Googlebot not blocked, HTTP 200 status, indexable content; meeting them does not mean a page will be indexed
limitations: Minimum requirements only; says nothing about ranking.

title: Spam policies for Google web search
measures: Definitions of prohibited practices including doorway abuse (for example many city pages that funnel to one page) and link spam
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
measures: Self-assessment questions about content quality, first-hand expertise and E-E-A-T; states E-E-A-T is not itself a specific ranking factor
limitations: Self-assessment guidance, not a checklist of ranking signals.

title: How to specify a canonical with rel=canonical and other methods
measures: How to indicate the preferred URL among duplicates
limitations: Canonical signals are hints Google may override.

title: Mobile site and mobile-first indexing best practices
measures: Google uses the mobile version of content, crawled with the smartphone agent, for indexing and ranking; mobile and desktop content should match
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Understanding Core Web Vitals and Google search results
measures: Definitions and targets: LCP within 2.5 seconds, INP under 200 milliseconds, CLS under 0.1
limitations: Google describes Core Web Vitals as aligned with what ranking systems reward, not as a decisive factor; field data needs enough traffic.

title: Debug Google Search traffic drops
measures: Main causes of organic traffic drops: algorithmic updates, technical issues, security issues, spam/manual actions, seasonality and changing interest
limitations: Diagnostic guide; causes can overlap.

title: Page indexing report
measures: Meanings of indexing statuses such as Crawled - currently not indexed, Discovered - currently not indexed, duplicate and canonical statuses, blocked by robots.txt, soft 404
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: URL Inspection tool
measures: How to inspect the indexed and live version of a single URL, including Google-selected canonical
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Performance report (Search results)
measures: Definitions of clicks, impressions and average position in Search Console
limitations: Covers Google Search only; does not include Business Profile interactions.

title: Tips to improve your local ranking on Google
measures: Local results mainly based on relevance, distance and prominence; there is no way to request or pay for a better local ranking; reviews and links feed prominence
limitations: Google keeps ranking details confidential; the page names factors, not weights. The page text says relevance, distance and popularity in one sentence and uses the heading Prominence.

title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google
measures: Name, address, category, signage, virtual office, co-working, one-profile-per-location and individual practitioner rules (dentists named as practitioners)
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Manage your business category
measures: Primary and additional categories; categories affect local ranking; editing a category may trigger re-verification
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Manage your business address
measures: Address entry rules, map pin, suite numbers; profile changes usually show in about 10 minutes but can take up to 30 days
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Verify your business on Google
measures: Verification methods (phone/text, email, video, mail) are determined by Google; what to show on a live video verification call
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Resolve duplicate profiles and ownership issues
measures: One profile per business; duplicates do not show on Search or Maps; merge requests via Maps; evidence of permanent signage for distinct businesses at one address; relocations should update the existing profile
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Fix suspended or disabled profiles
measures: Appeals tool steps; evidence that can strengthen an appeal (registration, licence, tax certificates, utility bills); name and address on documents should match; appeals submitted once; additional review after denial; bulk appeals for more than 10 profiles; account restrictions
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Appeal Business Profile content and profile restrictions
measures: Prepare evidence before submitting; appeal reviews and decisions can take up to 5 business days; do not submit multiple appeals or create a new profile; differences for UK/EEA
limitations: Review time is Google's stated estimate, not a commitment.

title: Prohibited and restricted content
measures: Fake engagement, incentivised reviews, selective solicitation (review gating) and impersonation rules
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Business Profile restrictions for policy violations
measures: Restrictions Google may apply after fake-engagement violations (pausing new reviews, unpublishing reviews, warnings) and how to appeal
limitations: Help page; Google may change it without notice. Content shown is what the page said on the retrieval date.

title: Understand your Business Profile performance and insights
measures: Definitions of profile views, searches, directions, calls (taps on the call button), website clicks, bookings; data includes organic and Google Ads; verified profiles only
limitations: Calls count button taps, not completed or answered calls; metrics vary by business type.

title: Business Profile third-party policies
measures: Rules for agencies: businesses keep ownership, 7-business-day handback, disclosure of management fees and that Business Profile has no extra cost, separate reporting, no promises of top placement

title: Understand how Google sources and uses info in Business Profiles and local search results
measures: Profile information comes from owners, crawled web content, licensed third-party data and user contributions
